rust_summary: turning parts of a block entity's kept geometry (`BlockEntityDraw::spin`, `still`): the game turns them each frame from the game time.
doc_summary: `BlockEntityDraw::spin(axis, pivot, degrees_per_tick, phase)` makes what is drawn next turn by itself and `still` ends it; kept with `keep`, a turning shaft is drawn every frame with no call of `native_block_entity_submit` until its block entity changes. Bundles need "hooks": @API:spinning_geometry@.
